crossRefs.note: The children of Gad built Dibon, Ataroth, Aroer,

people.name: Gad
people.line: Israelite tribe; descended from Gad, son of Jacob.

people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

translations.web: Moses gave to the tribe of Gad, to the children of Gad, according to their families.
translations.bsb: This is what Moses had given to the clans of the tribe of Gad:
translations.kjv: And Moses gave inheritance unto the tribe of Gad, even unto the children of Gad according to their families.
translations.asv: And Moses gave unto the tribe of Gad, unto the children of Gad, according to their families.
